text:
The brooch starts in the black trunk, then is moved to the blue drawer, back to the black trunk, then to the blue drawer, and finally to the wicker basket.

ANSWER: C

Yara sees Luca move the brooch to the blue drawer and then to the wicker basket, so she believes it is in the wicker basket.

ANSWER: A

Tariq’s latest information is that the brooch is in the blue drawer. He doesn’t learn about the later moves.

ANSWER: D

Tariq’s latest information is Luca’s text saying the brooch is in the blue drawer. The later moves aren’t described as something Tariq sees or hears, so he goes to the blue drawer first.

ANSWER: A

Farah sees Yara move the brooch to the black trunk before leaving. Yara doesn’t know Farah later watches Luca move it, so Yara thinks Farah still believes it is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: C

Yara believes Farah last saw the brooch moved into the black trunk before leaving the study. Since Yara does not know Farah is watching through the window, she expects Farah to open the black trunk first.

ANSWER: B

Yara knows Tariq saw the brooch put in the black trunk, but she missed Farah’s update and doesn’t know Tariq heard it or received Luca’s text. So she thinks Tariq still believes it is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: A

Yara sees Luca move the brooch into the wicker basket, so she thinks it is there. Oksana sees Yara witness that move, and Yara sees Oksana witness it too. Farah watches them through the window, so she thinks Yara thinks Oksana thinks Yara believes the brooch is in the wicker basket.

ANSWER: B

Tariq thinks Farah believes he saw Oksana move the brooch to the blue drawer before he left. Farah has no reason to think he learned about the later moves, so Tariq thinks she believes he still thinks it is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: C

Luca knows the brooch is in the wicker basket. Luca thinks Oksana and Yara saw it moved there, but thinks Tariq’s latest information is that it was in the blue drawer and Farah last saw it moved to the black trunk. So Luca would send notes to Tariq and Farah.

ANSWER: Tariq, Farah

Tariq reads Luca’s text saying the brooch is in the blue drawer. Luca knows Tariq reads it, and no later update reaches Tariq, so Luca thinks Tariq believes it is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: D

Farah knows Luca ends up believing the brooch is in the wicker basket. But she thinks Tariq left before Luca returned and therefore didn’t see the later events. Tariq saw Luca leave while the brooch was in the black trunk, then saw Oksana move it while Luca was away. Farah thinks Tariq believes Luca still thinks it is in the black trunk—and that Tariq thinks she believes the same.

ANSWER: D

The latest reassignment was in step 7, when Amara assigned the Marlow account to the Nairobi office. The later direct messages only report information; they do not change the assignment.

ANSWER: C

Amara’s latest information is from call 7, when she reassigns the account to Nairobi. Nothing afterward tells her it changed again, so she thinks it is with the Nairobi office.

ANSWER: D

Mirela hears the account list read as Denver on call 6, then Pablo’s message confirms Denver. She does not hear the later reassignment to Nairobi.

ANSWER: D

Mirela last learns that the account is with the Denver office from Pablo’s direct message. She believes it, so she answers Denver.

ANSWER: C

Tariq put the whistle in the copper tin, and the story describes no one moving it. Amara’s statement confirms it.

ANSWER: C

Amara last learns from Yara’s misleading text that the marble is in the white cabinet. She has no later information about the marble, so she thinks it is there.

ANSWER: D

Yara missed Tariq putting the whistle in the copper tin, but later heard Amara say it was there. She believes what she is told, so she thinks the whistle is in the copper tin.

ANSWER: C

Quinn hears Pablo read that the Marlow account is with Denver, so Quinn thinks Pablo believes it is with Denver. Quinn does not know about the later private message to Pablo.

ANSWER: D

Quinn believes Pablo’s latest known information is the account list reading that it was with Denver. Quinn doesn’t know about Luca’s private message to Pablo, so Quinn expects Pablo to answer Denver.

ANSWER: B

Pablo directly tells Mirela that the account is with the Denver office, and he knows she reads the message. He therefore thinks she believes it is with Denver. Luca’s later message to Pablo does not tell him what Mirela believes.

ANSWER: A

Amara last learned that the marble was in the white cabinet from Yara’s text. She did not see Yara move it afterward, so she opens the white cabinet first.

ANSWER: B

Jonas watched Yara move the marble to the green cupboard, so that is the container he will open first.

ANSWER: B

Pablo tells Mirela that the account is with Denver, and she reads the message at once. Mirela therefore thinks Pablo knows she believes the account is with Denver. She doesn’t learn about Luca’s later message to Pablo.

ANSWER: D

Mirela’s view is that the account is with Denver. She knows Quinn, Pablo and Amara heard the Denver readout on call 6, and Pablo’s message confirms his view. The latest assignment she knows Luca heard was Nairobi on call 3; she doesn’t know about his later updates, so she believes he thinks the account is with Nairobi.

ANSWER: Luca

Tariq saw Luca put the marble in the white cabinet, and believes Luca left before Yara moved it to the green cupboard. So Tariq thinks Luca believes it is in the white cabinet. Jonas believes this too.

ANSWER: C

Luca saw Tariq put the whistle in the copper tin and doesn’t realize Yara missed it, so he thinks Yara believes the whistle is in the copper tin.

ANSWER: D

Yara knows Jonas saw himself move the marble to the black trunk. She doesn’t know that he later saw Luca move it or that he watched her move it to the green cupboard, so she thinks Jonas still believes it is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: D

The final reassignment sets the Marlow account to the Osaka office.

ANSWER: B

Wanjiru hears the account reassigned to Nairobi in step 4. She is not told about the later reassignment to Osaka, so she still thinks the account is in Nairobi.

ANSWER: D

Wanjiru last heard that she reassigned the account to the Nairobi office. She was not on the later call where Ines changed it to Osaka, so she still believes it is in Nairobi.

ANSWER: C

Ines was on the call when Xavier fixed Porto as the offsite location, so she knows the offsite is in Porto.

ANSWER: D

Luca believes Mirela heard Pablo reassign the account to Lisbon on call 2. He also saw her on call 3, when Pablo was visibly absent, so he believes she thinks Pablo did not hear the reassignment to Nairobi. Luca does not know about Mirela’s later listening or Pablo’s message to her, and his own message to Pablo is private. So Luca thinks Mirela thinks Pablo still believes the account is with Lisbon.

ANSWER: A

Amara believes Pablo missed the call in step 3, and she has no knowledge of the later private messages. From her perspective, Pablo knows Luca heard the Lisbon reassignment in step 2, but not any later reassignment Luca heard. Pablo also knows Luca was absent when he read out Denver in step 6. So Amara thinks Pablo thinks Quinn thinks Luca thinks the account is with Lisbon.

ANSWER: B

Amara believes copper because Tariq told her so. Jonas hears Amara say it while Tariq is present, so Amara thinks Jonas believes Tariq heard and believes that Amara thinks the whistle is in the copper tin.

ANSWER: C

Pablo’s DM tells Mirela Denver, and Pablo knows she reads it. Luca’s later Nairobi DM changes Pablo’s own belief, but Mirela doesn’t receive that update. So Pablo thinks Mirela still believes he thinks she believes Denver.

ANSWER: D

Xavier hears Wanjiru reassign the account to Nairobi on their call, so he thinks Wanjiru thinks it is in Nairobi.

ANSWER: C

Luca saw Tariq put the whistle in the copper tin, but Amara was absent. He doesn’t know Tariq privately texted Amara, and he doesn’t hear her later statement from outside. So Luca thinks Amara has no idea where the whistle is.

ANSWER: E

Ines directly tells Hana that the offsite is in Porto, and Ines knows Hana reads the message at once. Hana therefore thinks Ines thinks she believes the offsite is in Porto.

ANSWER: C
ANSWER: D

The last physical move puts the medal in the black trunk. The later messages do not move it.

ANSWER: D

Yara saw Jonas move the marble to the black trunk, then left before Luca moved it to the white cabinet. Luca knows Jonas saw both events and knows Yara missed Luca’s move, so Luca thinks Jonas thinks Yara still believes it is in the black trunk. Luca does not know about the later text or Yara’s move back to the green cupboard.

ANSWER: A

Oksana last learns the medal’s location from Quinn’s text, which says it is in the white cabinet. She receives no later information.

ANSWER: A

Oksana’s latest information is Quinn’s message saying the medal is in the white cabinet, so she opens that first.

ANSWER: D

Ines sees herself move the medal to the black trunk, and nothing later changes what she knows.

ANSWER: B

Xavier believes the account is in Nairobi. He can tell that Wanjiru shares this view. He thinks Ines and Hana believe it is in Osaka, and Keiko believes it is in Denver, so he messages those three.

ANSWER: Ines, Hana, Keiko

Luca does not know Jonas was watching through the window, so Luca thinks Jonas’s view ended when they left the workshop. Jonas saw Yara know the marble was in the black trunk, but did not see Luca move it to the white cabinet while Yara was away. Since Tariq witnessed that same sequence, Luca thinks Jonas believes Tariq thinks Yara believes the marble is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: D

Keiko reads Quinn’s message to Soren saying the medal is in the black trunk. She believes Soren reads it too, so she thinks Soren believes it is there.

ANSWER: A

Keiko knows that Wanjiru heard Ines assign the account to Denver on the first call. Keiko wasn’t on the later reassignment calls, so she doesn’t know Wanjiru heard any later account changes. She therefore thinks Wanjiru thinks Ines thinks the account is in Denver.

ANSWER: A

Yara, Jonas and Tariq share Amara’s view after hearing her statement, or already know the whistle is in the copper tin. Luca appears to Amara to have missed the statement and have no idea, so she sends him a note—even though he actually saw Tariq put the whistle there.

ANSWER: Luca

Hana secretly hears the call where Porto is fixed and sees that Keiko is not on it. She is not on the later call where Keiko hears Xavier say Porto, and Ines’s message to Hana does not say that Keiko learned the location. So Hana thinks Keiko has no idea which city the offsite is in.

ANSWER: E

Ines knows she sent Keiko a message saying the medal was in the blue drawer, and she knows Keiko read it at once. Ines does not know Keiko secretly read the other messages, so she thinks Keiko believes the medal is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: A

The latest actual reassignment is Dalia’s in step 12, which assigns the Marlow account to the Osaka office.

ANSWER: D

On call 4, Wanjiru says the account has been reassigned to Nairobi, and Xavier hears her. Wanjiru believes Xavier heard it, so Xavier believes Wanjiru thinks he believes the account is in Nairobi. The later Osaka reassignment is on a call neither of them attends, so it doesn’t change this nested belief.

ANSWER: B

Quinn last believes the medal is in the black trunk because Ines texts him that location. Ines knows he reads her message, so Quinn thinks she believes he now thinks it is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: A

Keiko heard Wanjiru learn that the account was assigned to Denver on the first call. Keiko missed the later reassignments Wanjiru heard, and Wanjiru is absent when Osaka is set in the last call. So Keiko expects Wanjiru to say Denver.

ANSWER: C

Yara last learns that the account is with Lisbon, from Jonas’s direct message. She misses the reassignment on the final call, so she still thinks it is with Lisbon.

ANSWER: D

Keiko believes the medal is in the black trunk after secretly reading the two messages saying so. Ines doesn’t know Keiko read them, and believes Keiko’s latest information is her own text saying the medal is in the blue drawer. So Ines waits beside the blue drawer.

ANSWER: B

Yara last learned that the account was with the Lisbon office from Jonas’s direct message. She missed Dalia’s later reassignment, so she still believes it is with Lisbon.

ANSWER: B

Jonas last hears Dalia reassign the account to Osaka, so he thinks it is with the Osaka office.

ANSWER: B

Keiko knows Hana heard the initial Denver assignment, but Keiko missed the call where Hana and Ines heard the reassignment to Osaka. So Keiko thinks Hana still believes the account is in Denver, and thinks Ines believes that too.

ANSWER: C

On the last call, Oksana hears Dalia reassign the account to Osaka. Dalia therefore believes it is with Osaka, and Oksana knows that.

ANSWER: B

Quinn believes the medal is in the black trunk after Ines texts him. He then texts Soren that it is in the black trunk, so Quinn thinks Soren believes Quinn thinks it is there. Keiko secretly reads that text, so she knows Quinn holds that nested belief.

ANSWER: A

Dalia knows Oksana read her direct message saying the account was with Denver. Dalia doesn’t know Oksana later secretly heard the updates, so she still thinks Oksana believes it is with Denver.

ANSWER: D

Dalia knows Oksana heard the Lisbon update on call 2 and then received Dalia’s direct message saying Denver. Dalia doesn’t know Oksana secretly listened to the later calls, so Dalia expects Oksana to answer Denver.

ANSWER: C

The brooch is moved to the green cupboard, and it is not moved again.

ANSWER: B

On the final call, Jonas hears Dalia reassign the account to Osaka. Dalia can see that Jonas is on the call, so Jonas thinks Dalia knows he heard the reassignment and believes the account is with Osaka.

ANSWER: A

Keiko believes the brooch is in the wicker basket, then Amara’s misleading text updates her belief to the grey locker. Keiko doesn’t learn about the later move to the green cupboard.

ANSWER: D

Keiko sees the compass in the round tin when Quinn opens the tins, and later receives messages confirming it. Nothing changes the compass’s location.

ANSWER: B

Keiko last learns from Amara’s message that the brooch is in the grey locker. She doesn’t see the later move to the green cupboard, and she has no reason to doubt Amara’s message, so she opens the grey locker first.

ANSWER: B

Dalia believes the account is with Osaka. As far as she can tell, Rania, Yara, and Jonas heard the final reassignment, so she thinks they share her view. She knows she told Oksana it was with Denver, but doesn’t know Oksana learned anything later. So she messages Oksana.

ANSWER: Oksana

Keiko saw Quinn move the brooch into the wicker basket. Later, Amara told Keiko that it was in the grey locker; Keiko believes the newer information, despite Amara’s intention to mislead her. So Keiko will open the grey locker first.

ANSWER: D

Soren knows Keiko left before he moved the medal from the white cabinet, and he doesn’t know Keiko watched through the window. He also doesn’t know about Oksana’s private text to Keiko. So he thinks Oksana believes Keiko still thinks the medal is in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: B

Ines saw Quinn move the brooch to the wicker basket while Keiko was there too. Ines doesn’t know about Amara’s private text telling Keiko it was in the grey locker, so Ines thinks Keiko still believes it is in the wicker basket.

ANSWER: D

Soren’s view is that the medal is in the black trunk. He sees Ines put it there, and Quinn’s text confirms that Quinn believes it is there. Soren thinks Oksana and Keiko still believe it is in the white cabinet, based on what they saw before leaving.

ANSWER: Oksana, Keiko

Amara knows Keiko read her message saying the brooch was in the grey locker. Keiko believes what she is told, so Amara thinks Keiko thinks it is there.

ANSWER: D

Keiko believes Amara’s newer text that the brooch is in the grey locker. Amara knows Keiko reads the text, so Keiko thinks Amara thinks she believes the brooch is there.

ANSWER: D
ANSWER: E

Rania knows from the final call that Dalia thinks the account is with Osaka. But Rania doesn’t know Oksana secretly listened to that call, so she thinks Oksana’s latest information about Dalia is Dalia’s direct message saying Denver. Rania also thinks Oksana believes Rania’s own message saying Denver. So Rania thinks Oksana thinks Rania thinks Dalia thinks the account is with Denver.

ANSWER: A

The client workshop was last moved to Room Alder in step 5, and no later step changes its booking.

ANSWER: B

Uma hears the workshop moved from Alder to Fir, then hears Uma move it to Dogwood. She receives no later information about the workshop, so she still thinks it is in Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: B

Dalia thinks Oksana did not hear the later calls. From what Dalia thinks Oksana saw, Jonas heard Oksana assign the account to Osaka on the first call, then was absent when Rania reassigned it to Lisbon. So Dalia thinks Oksana believes Rania thinks Jonas still believes the account is with Osaka. The later Denver message does not tell Oksana that Jonas learned of a change.

ANSWER: A

Quinn knows Amara, Ines, and Emeka learned that the compass is in the round tin. Quinn doesn’t know Keiko watched the tins being opened, so Quinn thinks she has no idea and sends her a note.

ANSWER: Keiko

Keiko heard the workshop moved to Room Dogwood, then personally changed it to Room Alder. She later checked the booking system and heard that it was in Room Alder. No later information changes her belief.

ANSWER: A

Uma last learned that the client workshop was moved to Room Dogwood. She never learned about the later change to Room Alder, so she answers Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: D

Yara heard Uma move the client workshop to Room Dogwood on a call Uma attended. Yara learned later that the booking was in Room Alder, but she received no information that Uma learned of that change. So Yara thinks Uma believes it is in Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: D

Ines thinks Quinn believes the medal is in the black trunk, because she texted him that. But she does not know Keiko secretly read that text. From Ines’s perspective, Keiko’s relevant information is the earlier message from Ines saying the medal was in the blue drawer, so Ines thinks Keiko thinks Ines thinks Quinn believes it is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: A

Farah knows Keiko heard Uma move the workshop to Room Dogwood. Farah doesn’t learn that Keiko later moved it or read out Room Alder, so she still thinks Keiko thinks it is in Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: B

At call 6, Yara hears Keiko read that the workshop is booked in Room Alder, and Goran hears it too. Since Goran can see Yara on the call, Yara thinks Goran thinks she believes the workshop is in Room Alder.

ANSWER: B

Yara knows Oksana heard the Lisbon reassignment on the second call, but believes Oksana missed the later reassignment calls. Yara also has no knowledge of the private messages that later informed Oksana. So Yara thinks Rania thinks Oksana still thinks the account is with Lisbon.

ANSWER: C

Goran moves the harmonica to the red box at the end, so it is really there.

ANSWER: D
ANSWER: Uma

Farah heard Keiko hear that the workshop was moved to Room Dogwood. Farah later learns it is booked in Room Alder, but doesn’t learn that Keiko learned about that change. So Farah expects Keiko to say Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: D

Hana’s latest information is Bruno’s message saying the harmonica is in the wooden chest. She believes it, and she does not see Goran move it afterward.

ANSWER: B

Keiko believes Amara’s message that the brooch is in the grey locker. Amara knows Keiko reads the message, so Amara thinks Keiko believes that. Keiko doesn’t know Amara is trying to mislead her, so she thinks Amara believes Keiko accepts the message; Amara in turn thinks Keiko holds that belief.

ANSWER: B

Yara misses each offsite change and is never told that Farah messaged Uma. She therefore has no information that Uma learned a city, so she thinks Uma has no idea where the offsite is.

ANSWER: E

Farah heard the call where Goran and Yara both heard the workshop moved to Room Dogwood, so she thinks Goran thinks Yara believes it is in Dogwood. Farah does not learn about the later call where Yara hears that it is in Alder; Goran’s message to Farah only states the room, not what he thinks Yara believes.

ANSWER: A

Bruno sees Goran move the harmonica to the red box at the end, so he thinks it is there.

ANSWER: B

Hana last saw the harmonica put in the wicker basket, but then received Goran’s message saying it was in the red box and Bruno’s newer message saying it was in the wooden chest. She believes the newer message, so she opens the wooden chest first.

ANSWER: C

Amara believes Quinn did not read Keiko’s private text to Emeka. In Amara’s view, Quinn knows Keiko saw the brooch moved to the wicker basket after Emeka left, so Quinn thinks Keiko believes Emeka still thinks it is in the canvas sack, where he last saw it.

ANSWER: C

Keiko was in the garage when Quinn moved the brooch into the wicker basket, so Amara saw that Keiko knew it was there. Keiko was absent for the later moves. Quinn doesn’t know the content of Amara’s private text telling Keiko “grey locker,” so he doesn’t attribute that update to Amara.

ANSWER: B

Goran thinks Hana believed the harmonica was in the wicker basket when she left. He knows she read his message saying it was in the red box, and he doesn’t know about Bruno’s later message to her. So he thinks she now believes it is in the red box.

ANSWER: D

The latest actual change is at step 13, when Oksana moves the workshop to Room Fir. The later direct messages do not change the booking.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan last learned the booking was in Room Dogwood from Xavier’s direct message, so that replaces his earlier belief.

ANSWER: D

Goran knows Hana read his message saying the harmonica was in the red box. He doesn’t know Bruno later sent her a different message, so he thinks Hana believes it is in the red box.

ANSWER: A

Xavier’s latest update is from call 13, where he hears Oksana move the workshop to Room Fir. He receives no later information that changes his belief.

ANSWER: B

Hana knows Chidi saw the harmonica in the grey locker before he left, but she then sent him a message saying it was in the wicker basket. She expects that newer information to guide him, and she doesn’t know he secretly read Bruno’s message saying wooden chest. So Hana waits by the wicker basket.

ANSWER: B

Goran knows Yara heard the Room Alder update on the call, but he believes Farah missed that call. In Goran’s view, Farah knows that both he and Yara heard Room Fir on the earlier call. His later message tells Farah the booking is now Alder, but says nothing about Yara’s belief—so Goran thinks Farah still believes Yara thinks it is Room Fir.

ANSWER: A

Hana thinks Chidi believes the harmonica is in the wicker basket: she knows he read her text saying it was there, but doesn’t know he secretly read Bruno’s message.

ANSWER: C

The workshop’s actual room is Fir after Oksana’s move on call 13, which Zoltan does not hear. His later messages from Oksana and Xavier both say Dogwood, so he believes it is in Dogwood and answers honestly with that room.

ANSWER: A
ANSWER: C

Jonas knows Goran heard the initial Dogwood booking, but Jonas later directly tells Goran that it is booked in Cedar, and knows Goran reads the message. Jonas receives no later information that would change his view of Goran’s belief.

ANSWER: C

Jonas knows that Goran read his message saying Room Cedar. Jonas learns nothing afterward that would change his expectation of what Goran believes, so he expects Goran to answer Room Cedar.

ANSWER: C

Chidi sees Goran move the harmonica into the grey locker before leaving the cellar, so Hana thinks Chidi believes Goran thinks it is in the grey locker. Hana doesn’t know Chidi watches from outside, and the later messages tell Chidi locations—not what Goran believes.

ANSWER: D

The torch is moved to the black trunk and is not moved again.

ANSWER: B

Goran sees Soren move the torch to the blue drawer before Goran leaves. He receives no later information about the torch, so he still believes it is there.

ANSWER: B

Wanjiru saw Bruno reveal the harmonica in the grey locker before she left. She thinks Chidi and Goran saw that too, so she thinks Chidi believes Goran thinks she still believes it is in the grey locker. Later moves and messages do not reach Wanjiru.

ANSWER: B

Soren sees Emeka move the magnet to the tall tin. He later sends Yara a misleading message, so he doesn’t believe the magnet is in the flat tin.

ANSWER: B

Goran saw Soren move the torch into the blue drawer. He learned of no later move of the torch, so he opens the blue drawer first.

ANSWER: B

At step 15, Xavier tells Zoltan the workshop is in Dogwood. Zoltan believes the message, and Xavier knows Zoltan reads it at once. So Zoltan thinks Xavier thinks he believes it is in Dogwood.

ANSWER: D

Goran’s own view is Room Fir. From what Goran knows, Oksana and Xavier also think Fir, while Zoltan thinks Elm and Jonas thinks Cedar. So he messages Zoltan and Jonas.

ANSWER: Zoltan, Jonas

Xavier does not know that Goran secretly heard the call where Jonas moved the workshop to Cedar or received Jonas’s message. Xavier knows Goran and Jonas both heard the initial booking in Dogwood, but he sees no later call or message that would tell Goran what Jonas thinks. So Xavier thinks Goran still thinks Jonas believes it is booked in Dogwood.

ANSWER: D

Goran and Farah both think Yara heard Farah’s latest move, which set the offsite to Ghent. So the nested belief points to Ghent.

ANSWER: C

Oksana sees Emeka move the magnet into the tall tin. Emeka knows where he put it, so Oksana thinks Emeka thinks it is in the tall tin.

ANSWER: A

Soren watches Oksana open the containers and sees the torch in the red box. He does not see her later move it to the black trunk, and receives no later information about the torch. So he will first open the red box.

ANSWER: C

Chidi’s latest information about the harmonica is Bruno’s message saying it is in the wooden chest, so Chidi thinks it is there. Chidi believes Bruno and Hana share that view: Bruno sent the message, and Hana received it. Chidi thinks Goran last knew it was in the wooden chest, since Chidi saw Goran put it there. But Chidi thinks Wanjiru saw the harmonica revealed in the grey locker and left before learning otherwise. So Wanjiru is the only person Chidi thinks disagrees.

ANSWER: Wanjiru

Zoltan’s own belief is Dogwood, based on Oksana’s and Xavier’s messages. But Jonas last heard a room update on call 9, when Zoltan set the room to Fir. Jonas was on that call with Xavier, so Zoltan believes Jonas thinks Xavier knows Jonas thinks it is Fir. The later updates and messages did not reach Jonas.

ANSWER: A

Luca switches the packaging supplier to Sablewood in event 13, and there are no later supplier changes.

ANSWER: A

Oksana saw Soren move the torch to the blue drawer, so she thinks he believes it is there. She doesn’t know he watched her later move it, so she doesn’t think his belief changed.

ANSWER: B

Uma’s latest information about the account is Goran’s message saying it is with the Osaka office. She does not hear about the later reassignment.

ANSWER: B

Uma last learns that the Marlow account is with the Osaka office. She does not hear about the later reassignment to Denver.

ANSWER: A

Luca hears Goran reassign the account to Denver in step 4, then changes it to Osaka in step 10. In step 15, Luca hears Zoltan reassign it to Denver, so Luca thinks it is with the Denver office.

ANSWER: D

Emeka puts the magnet in the tall tin while Soren is present, so Soren sees the move. Emeka also sees Soren there, so Soren thinks Emeka knows the magnet is in the tall tin; the same observed move supports each further level of the nested belief.

ANSWER: D

Bruno heard Goran pick Ironbridge on a call that Luca also joined, so Bruno thinks Luca believes the supplier is Ironbridge. Bruno was not on the later call when Luca switched it to Sablewood and was never told about that change.

ANSWER: A

Bruno heard Goran pick Ironbridge on a call with Luca, and Bruno never learns that Luca later switches the supplier to Sablewood. Bruno expects Luca to say Ironbridge.

ANSWER: D

Soren knows the torch is in the black trunk: he saw Oksana move it there. He can tell that Yara and Oksana believe it is there too. Emeka and Goran last saw Soren move it to the blue drawer, and Soren knows they received no later information about the torch. He would send them notes.

ANSWER: Emeka, Goran

In the final call, Luca hears Zoltan reassign the account to Denver, and Goran hears it too. So Goran thinks Luca believes the account is with Denver.

ANSWER: C

Emeka saw Soren move the torch to the blue drawer and did not realise Yara missed it, so he thinks Yara believes it is in the blue drawer. Yara later learns from Oksana that it is in the black trunk, but Emeka does not learn that; Yara therefore thinks Emeka still believes she thinks it is in the blue drawer.
